input: How has JPMorgan Chase's net interest income trended over the three fiscal years 2023-2025?
final_output: JPMorgan Chase's net interest income increased over the three-year period from 2023 to 2025. In 2023, total interest income was $171,068 million and total interest expense was $81,321 million. In 2024, total interest income was $194,410 million and total interest expense was $101,350 million. For 2025, net interest income (NII) was $95.4 billion, up 3% compared to 2024. NII excluding Markets was $92.6 billion in 2025, flat when compared with 2024.
